description: Read slides with shape ids. outline: Markdown, each block under its shape id (escaped; never paste it back as text). geometry: each shape's kind, box, z-order, fill, line, text, font sizes and drawn text colour with its source. compact: id, kind, box, fill, text size and colour, first words per shape. svg: an SVG per slide, data-id per shape.

slides.description: Slide numbers from 1, or ids (s:256, $ref); layouts L2, masters M0. Default all.

name: ppt_read_slides
